name: Gloss Finish Protectant (Jasmine) with Microfiber
description: Premium gloss finish protectant infused with a soothing Jasmine fragrance.
longDescription:
Elevate the look of your car's interior and exterior with the Prato Gloss Finish Protectant, exclusively available at ENGINEZ. This premium formula delivers a stunning, long-lasting shine while providing essential protection.

Key Features:

UV Protection Restores Luster Anti-Static Silicone Polymer Formula
  • Deep Shine: Unique polymer silicone formula penetrates deep into the surface to shine and protect vinyl, rubber, and plastic.
  • UV Defense: Helps protect surfaces from fading and cracking by reducing ultraviolet light damage.
  • Restores Color: Brings out the original color, restoring luster and shine.
  • Anti-Static: Reduces static electricity to help repel dust and dirt.
  • Protects Against Abrasion: Adds a protective layer against everyday wear and tear.

Tip: If less shine is desired, lightly buff the surface with a damp cloth.
howToUse:
Usage Directions

1

Prepare the Surface

Thoroughly clean the surface with a high-quality cleaner. Ensure the area is free of dust and dirt before application.

2

Apply the Protectant

Apply Prato Gloss Finish Protectant with a clean cloth or sponge. For spray bottles, spray directly onto the applicator or surface.

3

Spread & Buff

Spread evenly and allow it to penetrate for a few minutes. Remove any excess product with a clean, dry microfiber cloth.

⚠️ Important Safety Warnings:

Not for use on: Floor, vehicle controls (pedals, grips, steering wheels), bench/cycle seats, cycle tires, brake drums, or other surfaces where slipperiness may be hazardous.

Do not use on: Clear plastic, plexiglas, glass (may cause smearing), fabric, woven materials, or paint.

Storage: Do not expose to heat or store at temperatures above 120°F. Keep away from sources of ignition.

First Aid: Avoid contact with eyes. If eye contact occurs, flush thoroughly with water for 15 minutes.

KEEP AWAY FROM CHILDREN AND ANIMALS.
